text: Read carefully the following poem. The poet is writing about the time when her daughter has left
home in order to study.
How does the poet memorably convey her feelings about her daughter leaving home?
To help you answer this question, you might consider:
• how she portrays the house and her daughter’s room
• how the poet conveys her feelings when her daughter returns and then leaves again
• how she conveys her feelings in the final section of the poem.
Empty Nest
Dear child, the house pines when you leave.
I research whether there is any bird who grieves
over its empty nest.
Your vacant room
is a still-life framed by the unclosed door;
read by sunlight, an open book on the floor.
I fold the laundry; hang your flower dress
in darkness. Forget-me-nots .
Beyond the tall fence, I hear horse-chestnuts
counting themselves.
Then autumn; Christmas.
You come and go, singing. Then ice; snowdrops .
Our home hides its face in hands of silence.
I knew mothering, but not this other thing
which hefts my heart each day. Heavier.
Now I know.
This is the shy sorrow. It will not speak up.
I play one chord on the piano;
it vanishes, tactful,
as dusk muffles the garden; a magpie staring from its branch.
The marble girl standing by the bench.
From the local church, bells like a spelling.
And the evening star like a text.
And then what next 
forget-me-nots: small blue flowers
horse-chestnuts: species of tree which drops hard seed cases
snowdrops: white flowers that bloom in winter
hefts: heaves up
Or
Read carefully the following extract from a novel. The narrator is travelling on horseback across a
remote desert region. He is accompanied by a small group of men and ‘the girl’. One morning, a
storm approaches.
How does the writer vividly convey a sense of danger?
To help you answer this question, you might consider:
• how he portrays the approach of the storm
• his description of the storm and the reactions of the travellers
• how he conveys the impact that the storm has on them.
Rolling down upon us over the snowy plain is a gigantic black wave.
